| Phase Segment | Tokens | Segments | II Median | II 95% CI | II Mean | Mean 95% CI |
|---------------|--------|----------|-----------|-----------|---------|-------------|

Phases with naturally low attention sparsity suffer dramatically more from importance-based head eviction at s=0.15.
